title: Elf Bar Plus50 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pink Lemonade from the Elf Bar Plus50 refill pod range delivers a sparkling mix of tangy Lemon and sweet Red Berry notes for a bright, uplifting vape. The citrus adds a zesty freshness, while the berry tones bring a mellow sweetness to round out the flavour. Each Plus50 pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and can join two other pods in the Elf Bar Plus50 Pod Kit, with no mess or fuss. The integrated mesh coil delivers consistently smooth performance with discreet vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each pod is topped up via a prefilled 10ml refill pod, and together each pod and refill can deliver up to 5,500 puffs of flavour.
